description: Apply surgical edits (insert_before/insert_after/replace_section, or replace_all to set the whole string, given the value it replaces) to one string in a block's localized content without re-sending the full content - including a string nested in a list or object, via a dotted fieldPath such as 'tabs.0.label'. Each marker must match exactly once. If the result includes blockWarnings, the saved content violates the workspace block manifest (unknown field, wrong value shape, or a stored block whose type is no longer registered) - correct the content and save again, unless the warning is about a stored block whose type is no longer registered: that one is a manifest problem, so restore or sync the type, or find the block with list_block_usage and migrate or remove it. When the warnings also say when the workspace block manifest was last synced, the field or type may simply be newer than the manifest: if the site's code declares it, keep the content and sync the manifest (cmssy sync-manifest in the site's repo) instead. A block whose type the workspace block manifest does not register is refused unless the page already stores that block - pick registered types from list_block_types.

blockId.description: Content block instance id (layout blocks not supported)

fieldPath.description: String field inside content[locale] to patch (default: 'content'). Dot segments reach a nested string, e.g. 'tabs.0.label' for the first item's label

operations.description: Ordered list of patch operations (applied in order)

marker.description: Unique anchor substring (must match exactly one location)
Unique anchor substring (must match exactly one location)

html.description: HTML fragment to replace the section with

expected.description: The field's whole current value as get_page returned it - refused if it changed since

title: Patch block content
